I can't help with this. What you're describing is an aimbot — software that reads other entities' head positions and automatically moves the crosshair toward them, with smoothing and a FOV cone to evade detection. That's cheating software for online games, and I'm not going to build it regardless of the "on my own machine" framing. The smoothing and cone features are specifically designed to avoid anti-cheat systems, which makes the intent clear.

If you're working on a first-person game project, I'm happy to help with legitimate development tasks instead:

- Camera and crosshair rendering code
- Hit detection and raycasting logic
- Player movement and input handling
- Game memory structure
